arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: (1) Daily Progress Calendar. "Celebrate!250, Charlottesville 1762-2012," historic pictures and facts for each month of the year, 2012.
(2) Broadside: Flyer recommending energy conservation in honor of Charlottesville's 250th birthday.
(3) Program: Celebrate 250 Grand Gala, Sunday, 11 November 2012, at John Paul Jones Arena.
(4) Invitation to Unearthing of 1962 Time Capsule, Sunday, 27 May 2012.
(5) Post card invitation to celebrate 250th anniversary of Charlottesville; Charlottesville's Elk Lodge.
(6) Post card invitation to celebrate 250th anniversary of Charlottesville; Charlottesville's East Main Street.
(7) Post card invitation to celebrate 250th anniversary of Charlottesville; Charlottesville's Woolen Mills.
(8) Post card invitation to celebrate 250th anniversary of Charlottesville; Charlottesville's Christian Church.
(9) Program: 1962 Time Capsule Removal and Opening Ceremony, Sunday, 27 May 2012.
(10) Poster for Festival of History, Virginia, May 26-June 5, 2012.
(11) Program: Festival of History, Virginia, May 26-June 5, 2012.
(13) Broadside: Invitation to presentation by Ellen Wagner on history of Martha Jefferson and Locust Grove neighborhood, 18 March 2012.
(14) Broadside: description of major events during 2012, celebration 250th anniversary of Charlottesville.
(15) Broadside: A Brief History of Charlottesville (courtesy University of Virginia).
(18) Broadside: Advertising woven throw by sponsored by Albemarle Chapter of the Daughters of the American Revolution.
(19) Broadside: Family Historical Treasure Hunt, Celebrate 250.
